guide.title: Guide
guide.subtitle: How to use each feature in LabMate
guide.intro: Quick-start guide to every feature in LabMate.
guide.buffersBody: Browse verified buffer recipes (PBS, RIPA, Laemmli, etc.) organized by category. Use Target Volume slider to scale any recipe to your needs. Star recipes to add them to Favorites for quick access. Export individual recipes as TXT or copy to clipboard. Use Export All to download every recipe at once.
guide.protocolsBody: Step-by-step protocols for common lab procedures (Western blot, ChIP, RNA extraction, etc.). Each protocol includes a materials list so you can prepare everything before starting. Timers are built in — click any timed step to start a countdown.
guide.calcBody: Seven calculator modes: (1) Dilution — C₁V₁=C₂V₂ with practical pipetting instructions, (2) Mass — how much powder to weigh for a target molarity, (3) Molarity — find the concentration from a known mass, (4) % Solution — w/v or v/v percentage calculations, (5) Prep Calculator — total volume with dead-volume compensation, (6) SDS-PAGE Gel Calculator, (7) Unit Conversion — metric, imperial, and lab units.
guide.gelBody: Found inside the Buffers tab (click the gel icon). Choose resolving and stacking gel percentages, set the volume per gel, and specify how many gels. The calculator shows exact volumes of acrylamide, buffer, water, APS, and TEMED. Includes a MW separation range reference table.
guide.plateBody: Design multi-well plate layouts (6, 12, 24, 48, 96, 384-well). Click or drag to select wells, assign labels and colors, then confirm. Use Quick Templates for serial dilution, dose-response, or checkerboard patterns. Export as CSV, SVG image, or copy the layout as text.
guide.inventoryBody: Organize lab samples with a hierarchical storage system. Create locations (freezers, fridges, shelves), add boxes (cryo 9×9, 10×10, tip 8×12, etc.), and track samples in a visual grid. Each sample records type, quantity, concentration, passage, dates, owner, and tags. Color-coded by sample type. Export per-box or full inventory as CSV, backup as JSON. All data stored locally in your browser.
guide.shortcutsBody: Press ⌘K (Mac) or Ctrl+K (Windows/Linux) to open the global search. Search across all recipes, protocols, reagents, and tags from any tab.
guide.privacyBody: LabMate runs entirely in your browser. Your favorites, step progress, timer history, and all personal data are stored locally on your device using IndexedDB. No data is ever sent to our servers. No account required. No tracking. No cookies beyond essential browser storage. You own your data — export it anytime.
guide.refsCollapseDesc: Classic papers and manuals cited in this tool
guide.usageNote1: All buffer recipes are from standard lab manuals and classic papers listed below, widely verified.
guide.usageNote2: SDS-PAGE gel formulas are based on the Laemmli (1970) discontinuous electrophoresis system.
guide.usageNote3: Transfer buffer is based on the classic Towbin (1979) formula.
guide.usageNote4: DOI links for original literature can be clicked to go directly to publisher pages.
guide.usageNote5: Unit conversions in the calculator follow IUPAC standard definitions.
guide.usageNote6: We recommend verifying against original literature for your specific experimental needs.
guide.exportDesc: Download all your favorites, step progress, and settings as a JSON file. Use this to back up your data or transfer to another device.
guide.importDesc: Restore data from a previous export. This will merge with your current data (existing items will be overwritten if they conflict).
